scope: App-server client: one-shot review and isolated edit through vibe-app-server 2.26.1, one process per run; one active run per owning server/storage instance; five MCP tools; restart does not resume or replay work. There is one engine and no backend selector or backend config key.

verified.name: node-floor-20.19.0
verified.evidence_required: npm run verify:release passes on exactly Node 20.19.0 for the 2.0 source.
verified.evidence: 2026-10-14, preparing machine (macOS arm64): the 2.0.0 working tree at the version bump (parent commit 4716747) under exactly Node v20.19.0 and npm 10.8.2; npm run verify:release passed (lint, typecheck, build, 83 test files / 1244 tests, acceptance, secret scan, SBOM with 193 entries). No GitHub CI: the workflow token scope is skipped.

unverified.name: target-no-inference-conformance-check
unverified.evidence_required: On the target with the installed Vibe 2.26.1 and no provider: vibe-supervisor pin-manifest generated and then verified on the target (with the per-run hashing cost recorded), serverInfo.version 2.26.1, the initialize handshake, session/start with the supervisor profile, and the complete read-back (profile tools exact, no skills, MCP sources, connectors or hooks, bypass off, unified harness, each VIBE_* setting, thinking off), with no turn and no hosted inference.

unverified.name: native-readiness-on-candidate
unverified.evidence_required: On the intended Codex desktop connection, native readiness reports the server_version of the frozen archive under test; eligible, no blockers, free slot.

unverified.name: hosted-review-edit-confirmation
unverified.evidence_required: With a new owner allowance of two hosted runs: one review and one edit on the frozen fixture with readiness receipts, the edit verified independently in a disposable copy, both closed with verified cleanup. Stop on first failure; no retries.

unverified.name: mcp-client-disconnect-hosted
unverified.evidence_required: One real client disconnect during a running hosted run on the 2.0 engine, through the official client: the server exits, the worker process group is gone, the owner lock is released, the run is failed and never relaunched, the private directories are deleted, and an edit worktree is kept until vibe_close cleanup.

unverified.name: permission-ask-visible-in-effective-config
unverified.evidence_required: config/effective/read shows tools.<name>.permission = ask and the denylist for each profile tool (read from Vibe's source, not observed), and an in-workspace read_file reaches the approval handler rather than being allowed by default.

unverified.name: thinking-off-effect
unverified.evidence_required: Observe whether config/model/write reasoningEffort off stops the model from generating reasoning. The read-back confirms the setting only.

unverified.name: experiments-fetch-off
unverified.evidence_required: Observe whether experiments.enable = false stops Vibe's experiments request. The setting is read back; its effect is unknown.

unverified.name: nested-run-typescript-shape-and-gating
unverified.evidence_required: The hosted-review probe in docs/target-acceptance.md (step 6) shows that a write_file or edit called from inside run_typescript arrives as the same file_system.* effect and reaches deny. From Vibe's Rust tests and code reading only.

unverified.name: clean-account-install
unverified.evidence_required: Before stable 2.0.0, complete the documented fresh macOS Apple silicon account installation on a frozen, reviewable artifact, recording installation, registration, rollback, and cleanup.
unverified.decision: The owner performs it with a prepared packet.

delivery_requirements.source_ci: There is no GitHub CI and the workflow scope is skipped; npm run verify:release passes locally on the release commit.
delivery_requirements.stable_promotion: Every gate above, exact final source/archive identity, applicable confirmation and separate merge/tag/publication authorization remain required. Only the latest release is supported.
